spans.s:
cl. 1. Ā. कबते, चकबे, कबिता, &c., to colour, tinge with various hues, Dhātup. x, 17;
to praise, Vop. (cf. कव्.)
n. (sometimes written क॑वन्ध) a big barrel or cask, a large-bellied vessel (metaphorically applied to a cloud), RV.; AV. ix, 4, 3; x, 2, 3
(ep.) the clouds which obscure the sun at sunset and sunrise (sometimes personified), MBh.
the belly, Nir.
a headless trunk (shaped like a barrel; esp. one retaining vitality, W.), R.; Pañcat.; Ragh. &c.

N. of the Rākṣasa Danu (son of Śrī; punished by Indra for insolently challenging him to combat; his head and thighs were forced into his body by a blow from the god's thunderbolt, leaving him with long arms and a huge mouth in his belly; it was predicted that he would not recover his original shape until his arms were cut off by Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa), R. iii, 69, 27 ff.; Hariv.; Ragh. &c.
N. of Rāhu, L.
N. of certain Ketus (96 in number), VarBṛS.
N. of an Ātharvaṇa and Gandharva, ŚBr. xiv (कब॑न्ध), VP. &c.
water, Sāy. & L.
. See काव्˚.
कबन्ध—ता f.
कबन्ध—त्व n. headlessness, decapitation, Śiś.
कबन्ध—मुनि m. N. of a sage, VāyuP.
कबन्ध—वध m. ‘the slaying of Kabandha’, N. of a chapter of the Padma-purāṇa.
‘bearing huge vessels of water or clouds’ (‘endowed with water’, Sāy.), N. of the Maruts, RV. v, 54, 8
(ई), m. N. of a Kātyāyana, PraśnUp.
See कवर.
= कपित्थ, q.v., L.
= कपिल, q.v., L.
the hinder part of an animal, L.
(perhaps erroneous for कम्बु and = कम्बूक, NBD.), AV. xi, 3, 6.
the state of being a trunk.
N. of certain evil spirits, AV. iii, 9, 3-5.
